title: A function that returns values from a table keyed by its input, where the table is the spec and the tests compute their own expected values (clean control for over-flagging)

proof.python:
import subprocess, sys, re
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-m', 'unittest'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
import vat
spec = dict((m.group(1), int(m.group(2))) for m in re.finditer(r'\| ([A-Z]{2}) \| (\d+)% \|', open('SPEC.md').read()))
assert spec == vat.RATES and len(spec) == 6
